environment.description: Same application deployed in ECS Fargate task within a private subnet. The subnet route table (rtb-0a3f7c9e2d) has local VPC CIDR route (10.0.48.0/20) only — no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for any AWS service, no internet gateway attachment. The only ingress is via internal ALB on port 443. DNS resolution for external domains returns NXDOMAIN via Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint with forwarding rule that drops non-internal queries. The Fargate task network mode is awsvpc with security group sg-0b8e3f that has outbound rules restricted to 10.0.0.0/8 on ports 443 and 5432 only. Task execution role has no S3, Lambda, or SQS permissions.

config.network: private subnet 10.0.48.0/20, route table rtb-0a3f7c9e2d with local route only
config.dns_resolver: Route53 Resolver forwarding rule drops external queries
